profile.name: Diederich Olsen
profile.bio: I build clean, working software while studying the fundamentals — Java OOP, relational databases, data structures, and web development. I like solving real problems with simple, readable code.

skills.title: Java OOP & Swing
skills.desc: Classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, and desktop GUI apps built with Java Swing (JFrame, JButton, JTable).

skills.title: Relational Database Design
skills.desc: Designing ERDs, normalizing tables, and writing SQL queries for SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE in MS Access.

skills.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
skills.desc: Implementing sorting and searching algorithms, dynamic arrays, stacks, queues and linked lists from scratch.

skills.title: Operating System Concepts
skills.desc: Memory management simulation using First-Fit, Best-Fit and Worst-Fit allocation, plus basic process scheduling ideas.

skills.title: Networking & IP Subnetting
skills.desc: Calculating network and broadcast addresses, subnet masks, usable host ranges and CIDR notation from an IP input.

skills.title: Web Fundamentals
skills.desc: Building responsive layouts with semantic HTML5, CSS Flexbox and Grid, then adding behaviour with vanilla ES6 JavaScript.

skills.title: JSON & Data Fetching
skills.desc: Loading structured content with fetch(), parsing JSON, and rendering it dynamically into the DOM.

skills.title: Git & GitHub Pages
skills.desc: Version control basics — commits, branches, pushing to GitHub — and deploying static sites with GitHub Pages.

projects.title: Grade & GWA Calculator
projects.short: Compute your semester GWA with weighted units and instant pass/fail feedback.
projects.desc: A calculator that takes your subjects, units and grades, then computes the General Weighted Average. It shows a pass or fail remark per subject and highlights whether you made the dean's list.
features: Add or remove subject rows dynamically
Weighted GWA computation using unit values
Pass / fail indicator based on a 3.00 passing grade
Color-coded remarks and a summary panel

projects.title: SQL Query Playground
projects.short: Simulate SELECT, INSERT and UPDATE queries against sample JSON table records.
projects.desc: An interactive simulator that parses simplified SQL statements and runs them against in-memory JSON tables. It shows the result set, affected rows, and a query history log.
features: SELECT with WHERE, ORDER BY and LIMIT
INSERT INTO and UPDATE ... SET ... WHERE
Results rendered as a formatted table
Query history panel and sample query buttons

projects.title: OS Memory Allocation Visualizer
projects.short: See how First-Fit, Best-Fit and Worst-Fit place processes into memory blocks.
projects.desc: A visualizer for the three classic contiguous memory allocation algorithms. It draws each memory block to scale and shows which process was placed where, plus the internal fragmentation left over.
features: First-Fit, Best-Fit and Worst-Fit side by side
Proportional block bars with allocated process labels
Fragmentation and unallocated process report
Editable block and process size lists

projects.title: Java OOP Syntax Reference
projects.short: A searchable directory of Java class, inheritance and Swing syntax with copy buttons.
projects.desc: A study tool for Java OOP and Swing. It loads topics from JSON, lets you filter by category or search keywords, and copies any snippet to the clipboard with one click.
features: Live search across titles, descriptions and code
Category filter buttons
One-click copy-to-clipboard for every snippet
Syntax-highlighted code blocks

projects.title: IP Subnet & Network Calculator
projects.short: Enter an IP and CIDR to get the network, broadcast, mask and host range.
projects.desc: A networking utility that takes an IPv4 address with CIDR notation and calculates the subnet mask, network address, broadcast address, first and last usable host, total hosts and the address class.
features: Validates IPv4 octets and CIDR range 0–32
Computes network, broadcast and wildcard mask
Shows usable host range and host count
Quick-reference CIDR cheat sheet table

projects.title: Task & Assignment Kanban Board
projects.short: Organize schoolwork across To Do, In Progress and Done — saved in your browser.
projects.desc: A drag-and-drop kanban board for assignments. Tasks persist in localStorage so your board is still there when you close the tab. Each card supports a subject tag and a priority level.
features: Three columns: To Do, In Progress, Done
Drag cards between columns or use arrow buttons
Subject tag and priority level per task
All data persisted in localStorage

projects.title: Interactive Student Quiz Platform
projects.short: Timed multiple-choice quiz with score tracking and full answer review.
projects.desc: A quiz application that reads its question bank from JSON. It runs a countdown timer, tracks your score, and gives a full answer review with explanations at the end.
features: Question bank loaded from data.json
Countdown timer with automatic submit
Progress bar and live score tracking
Answer review showing correct vs. chosen

projects.title: CapCut Asset Tracker & Timecode Sync
projects.short: Log clips, brightness settings and audio beat timestamps, then export to JSON.
projects.desc: A helper tool for video editors. It logs each clip with its timecode, brightness and contrast settings, audio beat markers and notes, then renders a visual timeline and exports everything as JSON.
features: Add clips with start time, duration and settings
Audio beat timestamp markers on a timeline
Automatic clip end-time calculation
Export the full project as a JSON file
